# awscc_dataexchange_event_action (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::DataExchange::EventAction



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `action` (Attributes) What occurs after a certain event. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action))
- `arn` (String) The ARN for the event action.
- `created_at` (String) The date and time that the event action was created, in ISO 8601 format.
- `event` (Attributes) What occurs to start an action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--event))
- `event_action_id` (String) The unique identifier for the event action.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags for the event action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time that the event action was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

<a id="nestedatt--action"></a>

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.export_revision_to_s3`

Read-Only:

- `encryption` (Attributes) Encryption configuration of the export job. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3--encryption))
- `revision_destination` (Attributes) A revision destination is the Amazon S3 bucket folder destination to where the export will be sent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3--revision_destination))

<a id="nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3--encryption"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.export_revision_to_s3.encryption`

Read-Only:

- `kms_key_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key you want to use to encrypt the Amazon S3 objects.
- `type` (String) The type of server side encryption used for encrypting the objects in Amazon S3.


<a id="nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3--revision_destination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.export_revision_to_s3.revision_destination`

Read-Only:

- `key_pattern` (String) A string representing the pattern for generated names of the individual assets in the revision.
